title: Caching a rarely changing API response

concepts.description: An ETag lets the client send If-None-Match and receive a 304 with no body when nothing changed.
concepts.context: catalog.ts compares If-None-Match with the hash-based ETag and answers 304 without the body

concepts.description: stale-while-revalidate lets a cache serve an expired response immediately while it refetches in the background.
concepts.context: the Cache-Control header in catalog.ts adds stale-while-revalidate=300 after max-age=60

concepts.description: Vary names the request headers a cache must key on, so a response for one language is not served to another.
concepts.context: catalog.ts sets Vary: Accept-Language so cached catalogs do not leak across languages
